scientific_integrity: The new finite certificate is exact integer arithmetic, while published analytic estimates handle the infinite high-degree tail. No false computational extrapolation or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the circle, integer harmonic degrees, and the radial-angular mixed norm at exponent six only. The high-order bound and sharp stability transfer rely on a cited theorem. No other exponent, complete adjacent-mode monotonicity, or ordinary unmixed restriction constant is claimed.
title: First-harmonic sharp sixth-power stability for circular mixed Fourier extension
